scope: Balanced A32/A64/B/B/A64/A32 controls, retaining the faster measured API reference independently on each side. Qualified two-bank streamed vision plus four-step native C64 with original caps and independently qualified full R128 outputs. API vLLM reference search at C32 and C64, max_model_len1024, gpu_memory_utilization0.65, automatic cache sizing (no override). Both run before native; choose the faster current control, then reverse the native/reference order with that fixed configuration. Auto capacity, maximum supported concurrency, and memory probe are retained in each server log. Reference concurrency and admitted capacity may differ from native; this measures usable framework throughput on a shared machine, not equal-concurrency kernel FLOPS. Original weights, three unique-UUID uncached fixtures, R128, max_tokens256, fresh serial strings; no own compilation/profiling during timings.
